desc: All Hi-Point®carbines are +P rated to accept all factory ammunition and feature: All-weather, polymer skeletonized stock; Sling, swivels and scope base; Internal recoil buffer in stock; Weaver style rails; Fully adjustable sights (rear peep & post front); Quick on/off thumb safety; Grip-mounted clip release; 100% American-made parts and assembly; 10-shot magazine (45 caliber comes with a 9-round magazine); FREE trigger lock; Last round lock open. Barrel length: 17.5". Overall length: 32"Weight: 7 lbs.. Sights: Fully-adjustable, Capacity: 9-shot magazine standard.
